provenance: IBM AMLworld HI-Small. Altman et al., 'Realistic Synthetic Financial Transactions for Anti-Money Laundering Models', NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks. Data: IBM Transactions for Anti-Money Laundering (AML), CDLA-Sharing-1.0. The corpus is entirely SYNTHETIC by IBM's own statement, generated by a multi-agent virtual world, not real customer data; what is real is the provenance, not the transactions. These are 8,192 rows of the held-out temporal test window, the last 30 percent of the timeline (2022-09-07 14:55 to 2022-09-18 16:18), which the model was not fitted, tuned or calibrated on. Their 32 features are computed by the training script's own functions, exactly as it computes them for test rows: per-account aggregates causal, so each row sees only earlier transactions, and structural features from the rows before the test window. Checked when this file was built: the published graph scores AUPRC 0.1233 over all 1,523,504 rows of that window, the figure the registry records. Unlike the 8-feature PaySim sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline.
split: a draw from the held-out temporal test window, the last 30 percent of the timeline, enriched to 2 percent laundering

input.layout: samples[i] is one row of the 32 features below

expected.note: Enriched to 164 laundering rows of 8,192 (2.0%); the test window's own rate is 0.15%, about 1 in 656, so an unenriched draw would hold about 12 and accuracy would be vacuous. Classified at the decision threshold 0.3869 the trainer chose on the validation window, as the browser does. The registry's minority-class F1 of 0.1519 is the same threshold over all 1,523,504 test rows at their real prevalence. The CKKS student scores 0.3132 on these rows, above this teacher, and 0.0614 over the whole window, below it: on these rows it flags 200 against the teacher's 23, and enrichment rewards whichever model flags more, so the order of the two on this sample is not a ranking.
